plan: A demon fighter who swings his sword in three hits and heals a huge amount in fights.
aSurveiller: His Q (The Darkin Blade). He strikes three times in an area and the tip of the sword knocks up: get out of the marked zones.
contrer: Dodge the tip of his blade (Q): that's where it hurts most and knocks you up.
Buy a Grievous Wounds item: he heals a lot, especially during his R.
Get out of his chains (W) fast before they pull you back to him.
forces: Big area damage with his Q.
His R makes him even stronger and almost revives him.
faiblesses: His hits are slow and easy to see.

sorts.P: Regularly, an empowered attack that heals him.
sorts.Q: Three sword swings; the tip knocks up.
sorts.W: Chain that pulls the target back if it doesn't leave the zone.
sorts.E: Short dash; he heals by damaging champions.
sorts.R: Demon form: more damage, speed and healing.

momentFort: Weak early. He scales with his Q: big spike at level 5 (Q rank 3), then at level 9 (Q maxed).
